answer: A willow whispers a newcomer in only by burning influence from its own vault, and a vault refills solely through the willow's own judged work, one unit per epoch, never by transfer or loan. Each whisper empties the vault, and the refill target rises as the square of the whispers that willow has already spent. To stack k clones through one willow, an operator waits out serial refills that lengthen with every head, or bribes many willows, each bribe sized to the paid income its empty vault forgoes. A lone newcomer spends one whisper from a full vault.
